messages:
Ivy: Weird ask but anyone into arcade cabinets? Found an old 90s cabinet in storage that still powers on but no joystick / coin mechanism. Thinking a little restoration + high-score challenge next Friday.
Sam: Ooh yes. I can bring a spare JAMMA harness (56-pin) and a couple of microswitches for joysticks.
Ruben: I know basic CRT safety: unplug before touching anything, discharge caps, etc. I also have a degaussing coil.
Mika: I can handle controls & buttons (Sanwa parts). Do we have a monitor adapter? If the CRT is composite only we might need an RGB-to-composite adapter or a small upscaler.
Ivy: Great. Cabin is in Storage Room B. facility-bot: Storage Room B access granted to Ivy for 2 hours on Fri 18:00-20:00.
Ally: I have a cheap OSSC upscaler (scanscan) and an HDMI capture dongle if we want to stream the high-score runs. Also happy to manage a tiny bracket.
Sam: Note re JAMMA: pin 46/47 can be coin switch. If coin mech is dead we can jumpered it to a button for free plays.
Ruben: Safety reminder: CRT implosion risk if you open the neck. Only touch the chassis after discharge. If unsure, ask me and Ill watch while you do swaps.
Mika: For joystick wiring the typical mapping I use:
- Up = red
- Down = blue
- Left = green
- Right = yellow
- Buttons = white/black pairs
(we'll label)
Ivy: Can someone bring a soldering iron and desolder braid? The harness has a corroded molex that needs reflowing.
Sam: Ill bring a soldering kit and some shrink tubing. Also spare microswitches.
Ally: Streaming idea: 2-hour block, 6pm setup, 7pm high-score challenge with teams of 2. Small prize: a vintage arcade sticker + free coffee. Whos in? React with emoji.
Ivy: In for sure.
Ruben: Im in (can teach quick CRT safety demo).
Mika: Ill bring parts & Sanwa buttons.
Sam: In. Also small tip if anyone wants to use PC-to-cabinet: some PC-to-JAMMA adapter boards map VGA/RGB correctlylook for "GBS8200" compatibility or OSSC for best scan conversion.
Ivy: Perfect. Final: setup 18:00, safety walkthrough 18:15, test runs 18:30, challenge 19:00. Thanks folks! :joystick: :trophy:
